repos_data.description: Real-time cost observability for Model Context Protocol (MCP) tool calls. Wraps any MCP server, attributes spend per tool/project/customer. Free tier 25K calls/mo. EU-hosted
Offline MCP server that predicts LLM call cost and recommends the cheapest capable model before you call it. No API keys, no network. npx @workswarm/modelcostsaver
